instruction: In the academicpages template cloned at ~/Code/Website, change the site title in _config.yml to 'My Research Page'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated file manager to ~/Code/Website/academicpages.github.io, opened _config.yml in text editor, attempted Find & Replace but used wrong search values (searched 'mona@emich.edu.org' which doesn't exist in the file). Then switched to terminal with grep/sed/nano but ultimately failed to correctly update all 3 required YAML fields.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate file system via file manager, open files in text editor, use Find & Replace dialog, open terminal, use grep/sed/nano commands, navigate to correct directory paths.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model confused field values during Find & Replace, used incorrect search strings, and failed to properly edit all 3 YAML fields (name, author.name, author.email). The multi-field requirement caused confusion between similar field names.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single YAML field edit (title). The original required 3 fields which confused the model. A single field edit is within demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires editing the 'title' field in _config.yml from 'Your Name / Site Title' to 'My Research Page'. Evaluator uses official check_json metric with is_yaml option and vm_file getter to verify the YAML field value.

scoring_breakdown.title_change: 1.0 - title field set to 'My Research Page'

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches _config.yml from the right path (/home/user/Code/Website/academicpages.github.io/_config.yml), matching the instruction's target file.
Metric (check_json with is_yaml=true) correctly parses the YAML file, navigates to the 'title' key, and checks equality with 'My Research Page' using _match_value_to_rule.
Expected value 'My Research Page' exactly matches what the instruction requires.
Complete coverage: the instruction has a single requirement (change site title) and the evaluator checks exactly that.
Postconfig (Ctrl+S) ensures the file is saved before evaluation, handling the case where the agent edits in a text editor.

Minor note: get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[...]] but check_json handles None gracefully (returns 0.0), so the type mismatch flagged by static analysis is not a runtime issue for single-file usage.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
